Scene:
一个人对神农说，麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？神农说，这就要看你想不想生病了。以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 麻烦我们可以吃什么植物：麻烦告诉我们……
- 以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃：后来，Time+以后；告诉人们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”；哪些，哪些

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 以后：后来，At the beginning of a sentence, “后来” means “afterwards”; “以后” usually means “after a specified event or time”. [vocab list]
Run 2: 以后：后来，when a new past event begins “afterwards,” use 后来; 以后 normally follows a stated time or event. [vocab list]
Run 3: 以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃：后来，神农告诉人们一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃，sentence-initial 以后 does not mean “afterwards”; use 后来. Also, 别人 distinguishes other people from a stated person or group, while 人们 refers to people generally. [vocab list]

output.reason: Runs 1 and 2 address only sentence-initial “以后,” while Run 3 additionally treats “别人” as an error.
